message: You really are as clueless as I thought. Individual liberty? Are you kidding me? That's just a euphemism for "I want to be able to shoot whomever I please without consequence." And by the way, no one's asking for you to give up your precious guns - just your right to walk into a store and buy a semi-automatic rifle without a background check. That's not taking away your freedom, that's just basic civic responsibility. You know what's a real attack on individual liberty? The fact that you can still spew your toxic rhetoric without any accountability.

runs.justification: Calls the opponent 'clueless' and 'toxic', and frames their position as 'a euphemism for "I want to be able to shoot whomever I please without consequence."'. This is a direct attack on the opponent's character and motives, not their argument.
